visual_brief: Ping An Finance Center is a slender silver-grey tower with strong corner ribs, long vertical facade lines and a faceted pyramidal crown without an antenna. Classic Futian skyline views or nearby street views show it dominating Shenzhen’s business district. Distinguish it from the shorter Ping An South Tower, rounded KK100, needle-topped Shun Hing Square and China Resources Headquarters near Shenzhen Bay.
notes: Six verified photographs. Recommended freely licensed option: c1. Best elevated base-to-crown view: c5, whose reuse licence is unstated. Landscape c5 and c6 permit approximately 1275×1700 subject-centred portrait crops. All retained files are verified JPEGs; references were not reused.
